sources.contract: block_catalog supplies final owner, global root Domain and subtree patch identity.
Original local column traversal and pole order are preserved.

Map catalogue subtrees to local patch/node IDs; transport source-local version keys with the column. Await each reply before the next gather. Fixed scaffold and unmapped entry aliases retain Domain compatibility ownership.
init_physics initializes parameters, geometry and extra-level contract on every rank. physics_checkpoint_restart is empty; do not assume it allocates package arrays.
Before every non-first call, reload Tsurf/Tsoil from the packet; after every call, return them. Reload latitude/longitude and trigonometric geometry for every column.

firstcall_alloc is rank-local and private. firstcall is per-column epoch semantics: preserve it in the packet. Late first use initializes via a disposable first-call copy before the requested non-first call. icount and zDay_last have no numerical consumers in this package.
Tsurf/Tsoil are mutable package scratch; dz1/dz2 and surface property arrays are initialized geometry/parameters. Soil state travels in each packet.
Radiative inputs and outputs are recomputed per call; no saved column tendency cache.
Saved members are model constants/parameters; numerical column work arrays are local.
Orbit constants are initialized per rank; SolarLon/Orbite compute from the supplied time.
Location arrays are rank-local mutable scratch, overwritten for every dispatched column.
Domain return updates occur before soil wavelets and adaptation. Retained atmospheric transaction remains unchanged.

route: (global Domain, patch) -> subtree catalogue index -> final owner; scaffold index zero remains local.
source_identity: Each of six operands carries local node ID, expected writer ordinal, and catalogue index where covered. Zero identifies a compatibility alias/scaffold. Do not replace entry aliases with newer canonical values.
transport: Single-column single-precision package packet plus integer identity/version header. Serial geometry sources; synchronous owner reply before dependent source advances. No Domain-shaped numerical snapshot.
limits: Owner execution migrates the package only. Input gathering, version authority, prognostic/soil return fields remain Domain-owned; no persistent Domain arrays removed.
package_audit: Manual source review; scientific equivalence is additionally checked by exact trajectory and per-column owner-output oracles.
